You are extending a small billed-smoke tool (offline until a human confirms) in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py and tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py (both exist; read them first). Never edit anything else. You never make a live call. NEVER print, log or write any credential value.

CHANGE, TESTS FIRST: (1) Add a fifth profile to VARIANTS, appended after the existing four: label `llama-3.3-70b`, model_id `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`, token_parameter `max_tokens`, max_tokens 1024, extra_body {}, input_price 0.293, output_price 2.253, note empty. (2) Add a CLI option `--variants` (comma-separated labels, order preserved, duplicates and unknown labels are an error reported through the existing _error path with the unknown label named; default = the original four labels in their original order, so `--dry/--run` without the option behaves EXACTLY as today: 24 calls, 6 per variant, round robin, same ceilings). `_build_plan` takes the label list and keeps the same six slots per variant round-robin; selecting only `llama-3.3-70b` gives 6 calls. The run-time guard stays: --max-calls must cover the plan, ceiling must not exceed --max-usd. `_run` and `_request_body` must work for the new profile (response text for this model arrives at result.response, which _extract_text already handles; response_format json_object and temperature 0 stay). (3) The report's per-variant summary lists only variants that have at least one row in the rows file (so a 6-row run does not print four empty sections), and the 'Failed variants' loop uses the same set. Existing 24-row reports must come out unchanged. Tests to add/keep: default plan is still the four, 24 calls; `--variants llama-3.3-70b` yields 6 calls with the right model id, `max_tokens` key (not max_completion_tokens) and ceiling = sum of per-call ceilings; unknown and duplicate labels are rejected without any network call; the request body for the new profile; the report for a 6-row llama-3.3-70b-only rows file omits the other four; all existing tests still pass unchanged except where they enumerate VARIANTS (update only those to the default four labels). Hermetic: tests never touch the network. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; run `screen.py --dry` then `smoke_direct.py --dry --variants llama-3.3-70b` against it with dummy env values and report the call count and ceiling USD.
